name: 4-3 Under Front Overload Collapse
formation: 4-3 Under Shift vs 11P Gun Trips Right

summary.motive: Create immediate organic pass-rush disruption using 4-3 Under front alignment angles to generate simultaneous weakside edge speed and strongside interior 3T penetration.
summary.whyItWorks: The Under front forces standard 5-man offensive lines into true 1-on-1 matchups across all interior gaps, allowing elite defensive linemen to win without blitzing.
summary.failureMode: A designed perimeter screen or quick toss crack away from the 3-technique into the weak B/C gap.

beats.title: Under Front Alignment Tilt
beats.text: Quinn shifts the defensive front into an Under alignment: the 1-technique NT and 3-technique DT dictate one-on-one isolations across the offensive line, while LEO is poised in Wide-9.

beats.title: Double Penetration Strikes
beats.text: At the snap, 3-tech DT explodes past the right guard with a quick arm-over while LEO beats the left tackle with outside speed, collapsing both flanks of the pocket instantly.

beats.title: Cover 3 Match Erases Trips Quick Concepts
beats.text: SAM steps in front of H’s quick out while Strong Safety carries Y’s vertical seam downfield, eliminating all quick release answers for the passer.

beats.title: Pincer-Movement Sack
beats.text: Trapped between the interior rush of the 3-technique and the perimeter bend of the LEO, the quarterback is engulfed for a massive 7-yard sack.

relations.tell: 1-tech and 3-tech shifted into Under front alignment with LEO stretched out in Wide-9 stance
